# Database Connection Issues

The _locked_session function can raise a CompileError due to DatabaseUnavailableError when attempting to check the connection to the database. If the database is inaccessible, it may prevent any operations that depend on it.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._locked_session`
